ID: RM-DOC-0108
Title: Corvenian forwarders see opportunity in canal closure
Source: Corvenia Courier
Published: 2025-03-07
Type: news_report
Event: EVT-A
Country: Corvenia; Brenmark
Sector: electronics
Tier: 3

Corvenian freight forwarders claim that rail and coastal alternatives can absorb up to 45 percent of rerouted cargo heading to Brenmark.

Skarport dock managers said they were hiring extra crews for the coastal feeder service.
